name: rebeca-contract
description: Contrato del API de Rebeca: openapi.yaml + tipos TypeScript generados + mocks MSW. Se consume por versión: npm i github:CYaranga/rebeca-contract#v1.0.0

scripts.build: npm run build:types && npm run build:mocks && npm run check
scripts.build:types: openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o types/index.d.ts && openapi-typescript v4/openapi.yaml -o types/v4.d.ts
scripts.lint: redocly lint openapi.yaml v4/openapi.yaml --skip-rule operation-4xx-response --skip-rule no-unused-components --skip-rule operation-description --skip-rule tag-description --skip-rule info-license
